# PULSE

PULSE is multichain crypto-market and prediction-market intelligence for humans and AI agents. One responsive workspace provides Crypto Market, Prediction Market, and Safety. It combines live OKX spot data with one explicitly selected, active crypto-focused Polymarket question and offers readable, recoverable Base or Premium reports on X Layer, Base, Arbitrum, and Arc Testnet. Polymarket is public read-only evidence; PULSE never places prediction-market orders.
